Messages.Author: dvorax
Messages.Body:
Hi,
I have a question about Gratiano's interaction with vote counting
cards like Leadership Vacuum or Political Struggle. I know the ruling
about Prisci with no votes "in general"[RTR 19970630]. But what about
this very special Priscus, with the additional vote.
a) How much counters do I put on the Vacuum, when Gratiano goes to
torpor?
b) How much votes does my vamp get, when Gratiano goes to torpor? (I'm
Almost 100% sure, that the answer is the same ;) ).

thanks
dvorax.

Messages.Author: Daneel
Messages.Body:



Any conditionality or divergence from the standard "1 vote, 2 vote" or
normal vote providing sect-based titles results in the votes in question
not counting as votes at all for any card or effect that counts the
general number of votes a given vampire possesses.

a) zero
b) zero

--
Bye,

Daneel

> "LSJ" <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote in message news:<2tsbgqF...@uni-berlin.de>...

Sorry, yes. Political Struggle and Leadership Vacuum counts the number of
votes a vampire "has", without regard to titles (although LV requires the
vampire to be a titled one in the first place). My previous "correct" was
in error.

The "zero. zero." part was correct -- Gratiano has no votes in the
main referendum, which is what those things are counting. But the votes
that those things do count (in the main referendum) are not limited
to the stanard "title" votes.

The votes granted by Political Struggle are not title votes, either.
They're just votes. Having votes doesn't necessarily make one titled.
